column1: # The uncovered count per declarative class that scripts/ratchet.sh will not let
# grow. Uncovered is scored minus behavioural: a mutation caught only by a pinned
# snapshot is uncovered, because the snapshot noticed the catalog move and nothing
# refused anything.
# Not a percentage. A percentage rises when the denominator grows, so a phase that
# added thirty uncovered policies to a class holding two would improve its score.
# The logic class is not here. It is gated site by site instead, against
# docs/review/refusal-sites.tsv and docs/review/refusal-dispositions.tsv, because a
# count would let a covered site be traded for an uncovered one.
# The middle column is what the enumeration produced, including the mutations
# that turn out to be degenerate or inapplicable and are excluded from the score.
# It is there so a class that vanishes is named in the failure message.
# class
check
loosen
unique
trigger
policy
weaken
rls
